7 Working without the originals

Previews are small, and originals are large and often offline. Two paths make previews useful on their own.

  • Lightroom’s previews. Lightroom Classic builds regular previews and Smart Previews. Lightroom Repair describes building and verifying them without disturbing the catalog.
  • Serving them as a library. diskproxy presents a folder as a virtual disk without writing it. Its previews plugin serves Smart Previews as DNG stand-ins with a large preview added, or preview JPEGs with camera EXIF spliced in from small stubs; the stubs can be written from phindex’s metadata records and kept in one SQLite store. An application such as Photo Mechanic then shows camera, lens, exposure and GPS for every preview. On a writable view, ratings, labels and flags it writes are captured as small XMP sidecars with a journal, and the source is never touched.

Bringing those ratings back into a Lightroom catalog has to go through Lightroom’s own writer; Lightroom Repair says what is and is not qualified for that.
